name: terminal-window
title: Terminal window
description: A terminal window framed in box-drawing glyphs that plays a scripted session: typed commands, streamed output, spinners, block progress bars and coloured ok, warn and error lines.

name: ascii-badge
title: ASCII badge
description: A status badge set in glyphs, such as [ OK ], < beta > or ┤ v2 ├, with tones from the palette, a fixed width for aligned columns and an optional live dot.

name: ascii-tabs
title: ASCII tabs
description: Tabs drawn as box-drawing folder tabs or a sliding glyph underline, with arrow-key navigation and a roving tab stop.

name: kbd-shortcut
title: Keyboard shortcut
description: Keyboard shortcuts drawn as box-drawing keycaps, with Mac and PC labels and caps that press down while the visitor holds the keys.

name: status-dot
title: Status dot
description: A one-glyph status indicator for online, busy, offline and error, with a distinct shape per state and a ping, turn or flash in glyphs.

name: glyph-trail
title: Glyph trail
description: A layer where the pointer paints glyphs that burn bright, cool through the charset and drift away like smoke, with a slow wanderer when nobody draws.
